description: Open the document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/trial_notes_template.docx containing unstructured trial notes from jury duty. Create a properly structured Civil Trial Notes document with: (1) Document header with case info, (2) Case Summary section, (3) Witness Testimony table with 5 columns containing 4 witness entries with bold names, (4) Evidence Log with Plaintiff's and Defendant's exhibits, (5) Timeline of Events with at least 5 entries and disputed items marked in italics, (6) Contradictions to Resolve section with 3+ numbered contradictions, (7) Questions for Deliberation with 3+ questions. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
